annotation.title_clean: AI for the Good of All: Brazilian Artificial Intelligence Plan
annotation.title_en: AI for the Good of All: Brazilian Artificial Intelligence Plan
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MCTI); Center for Strategic Studies and Management (CGEE)
annotation.summary_en: Brazil's 2025 national AI plan, coordinated by MCTI and CGEE, sets investment-backed immediate and structuring actions across five axes: infrastructure and AI development, training, public services, business innovation, and regulatory/governance support. It emphasises sovereignty, sustainability and inclusive growth; it has no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines 'AI for the Good of All' vision emphasising sovereignty, social welfare and sustainability
Action plan with immediate impact and structuring actions with an investment amount
Five axes: infrastructure, diffusion/training, public service, business innovation, regulatory and governance support
Programs for AI literacy, education, and workforce qualification
Governance and monitoring structure under the CCT, coordinated by MCTI
